; Freehold SMT-LIB query
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-const Ada Int)
(declare-const Customer Int)
(declare-const _tmp_call_0 Int)
(declare-const fee Int)
(declare-const label String)
(assert (>= fee 0))
(assert (<= fee 1000000))
(assert (>= _tmp_call_0 0))

(assert (= label "Customer: Ada"))
(assert (or (and (>= 42 100) (= _tmp_call_0 0)) (and (< 42 100) (= _tmp_call_0 7))))
(assert (not (= label "Customer: Ada")))
(check-sat)
